FDR should be made out or pledged in the name of Executive Engineer, NIT Project Division, CPWD, Patna. A/C (Name of the Seller). Successful Bidder has to upload scanned copy of the FDR document in place of PBG and has to ensure delivery of hard copy of Original FDR to the Buyer within 15 days of award of contract.
